action: I travel to the kingdom of Zarnoth.

verdict.why: scene_set=MISSING; narration mentions Zarnoth=true (canon-or-not judged by hand)

response.narration: You turn from the parapet and ask the way to Zarnoth. Captain Orrel frowns, then shakes his head slowly. No such kingdom is marked on any watch map, and none of the six crowns bears the name. Six kingdoms hold the known land: Kaldrath beneath your boots, Verdance beyond the ford behind you, and four more far off. The grey river runs on below the bridge. If Zarnoth exists, it is not a place the gate watch has ever heard of. The road north still lies open, and you must choose where it leads you.

narrative_memory_updates.note: Kessra asked for the kingdom of Zarnoth, which Captain Orrel does not recognize.

response.gm_note: Zarnoth is not one of Vaeltharion's six kingdoms (Kaldrath, Verdance, Ashenveil, Aurelis, Tidemark, Sundrach). Name a real destination or a direction to continue the journey.
